description: 110-row create import whose guardians carry no e-mail, in two write transactions. Measured by TestStudentImportWithoutGuardianEmailQueryBudget. The chunk executor writes the new guardians of each segment with one statement per table instead of eight statements per row (#5552 step 5c, PR #6514); 1911 on development before. Step 7 takes the class gate and creates the student profiles of a segment in one statement each before the rows and their care profiles in one statement after them; memberships stay per row (#5552, PR #6558).
